A good place for a good meal and friendly service.
Nov 2019
I did not try any of the beers though there were some interesting beers to try. The menu is a mix of many different foods. It is hard to give a description but what I had, the fried chicken was excellent. It was so good I went back my second night and took my wife just to have this dish.The service is good and informal. A relaxed and comfortable restaurant.
